items.t: Crocs, Inc. to Attend BNP Paribas Outdoor & Sports Conference and Present at The Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference
items.sum: Crocs, Inc. (NASDAQ: CROX), a world leader in innovative casual footwear for all, today announced that it will attend BNP Paribas Outdoor & Sports Conference on Thursday, November 19, 2026. In addition, the company will present at The Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference on Tuesday, December 01, 2026 at 11:45 AM ET.
